title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to ensure they are providing enough nutrients for both themselves and their baby. International pantry staples can be a part of a diverse and balanced diet.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
Some international pantry staples that are good for pregnancy include:
- Oats: rich in fiber, which can help support digestive health and reduce the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, which can help support the development of the baby's bones and teeth.
- Lentils: rich in protein, fiber, and iron, which can help support the development of the fetus.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which can help support the development of the baby's brain and vision.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, which can help support the development of the fetus.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, which can help support the immune system and reduce the risk of illness.

## Building Balanced Plates for Pregnancy
To build a diverse and balanced diet, expectant mothers can combine international pantry staples with traditional foods. For example:
- A bowl of oatmeal with Greek yogurt and fresh fruit.
- A lentil salad with leafy greens and citrus.
- Grilled low-mercury salmon with roasted vegetables and quinoa.
- Scrambled eggs with spinach and whole-grain toast.

## Food Safety Considerations
Expectant mothers need to be mindful of food safety when consuming international pantry staples. Some considerations include:
- Choosing fresh and clean ingredients.
- Washing hands before preparing and consuming food.
- Cooking food thoroughly before consumption.
- Avoiding foods that can cause food poisoning, such as raw or undercooked meat, poultry, and seafood.

## Conclusion
International pantry staples can be a part of a diverse and balanced diet for expectant mothers. However, it is essential to be mindful of food safety and choose fresh and clean ingredients.
